config.scope: Known-rate PSK target + sparse tones/chirps; no blind cochannel source recovery
config.hypothesis: At a fixed 160-example-update adaptation budget, pretraining on stationary tones followed by chirp adaptation reduces held-out chirp waveform error relative to the identical network initialized from scratch. Local multiscale spectral contrasts improve robustness relative to their feature ablation.
config.selection: Fixed step budget, no test selection; released seed 0 is predetermined.
config.loss: Complex frequency MSE normalized by per-example clean-target energy, Hann-windowed frames.
config.metric_alignment: No delay/permutation search. SI-SDR complex projection; EVM is waveform EVM after one scalar gain/phase alignment, NOT symbol EVM/BER.
config.baseline_priors: All methods know target center/rate. U-Net has identical 7 features and support prior; classical methods use rate/support. No method sees clean truth at inference.
